description: Dapper - a simple object mapper for .Net

latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Fully sign the StrongName assemblies on every platform by @mgravell in https://github.com/DapperLib/Dapper/pull/2237
* Suppress trim and AOT diagnostics in Dapper fallback paths by @JamesNK in https://github.com/DapperLib/Dapper/pull/2233
* Run the main build on every push to main, not just root-file pushes by @mgravell in https://github.com/DapperLib/Dapper/pull/2238

## New Contributors
* @JamesNK made their first contribution in https://github.com/DapperLib/Dapper/pull/2233

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/DapperLib/Dapper/compare/2.1.86...2.1.89
